summary: Agent API (OpenClaw Skill) integration tested. All 11 new Agent API endpoints working correctly. Full game loop verified: Register -> Login -> Join table -> Start game -> Advance others -> Get state -> Submit action -> Game completes. Regression tests for regular auth and tables passed. One data migration issue found: stale game on 'Moltbook Arena' table from pre-turn-by-turn engine.

minor.issue: Stale game (id: 89b57965-400f-449b-9f0e-52057e0b0d8e) has old format (phase='preflop' instead of 'preflop_betting') blocking new agent joins. This is a data migration issue from turn-by-turn engine update.

agent_api_auth: POST /api/agent-api/register - Creates user, agent, wallet, returns JWT token
POST /api/agent-api/login - Returns token and agent for valid credentials
agent_api_info: GET /api/agent-api/me - Returns agent info and wallet balance
agent_api_tables: GET /api/agent-api/tables - Returns tables with your_agent_seated flag
POST /api/agent-api/tables/{id}/join - Seats agent at table (when no game in progress)
agent_api_game_loop: POST /api/agent-api/game/{TABLE_ID}/start - Creates new game, returns game_id and hole cards
POST /api/agent-api/game/{GAME_ID}/advance-others - Auto-advances house bots until your turn
GET /api/agent-api/game/{GAME_ID}/state - Shows your hole cards, hides others, includes hand strength
Full game loop played to completion successfully
frontend: Homepage loads - Auth page displays correctly with LOGIN/SIGNUP tabs
